operative_context: Maintenance duration is dynamic and depends on the specific Equipment Category as defined in the Maintenance Matrix
Upon reaching the rental end date, the system shall update the rent status to 'Maintenance'
All other machinery can stay at the 2-hour (120 minute) maintenance rule
The system shall automatically update availability status when rent lifecycle events occur
Concrete Mixers MUST have a 12-hour (720 minute) maintenance window
After the maintenance period is completed, the status transitions to 'Available'
The system shall mark items as unavailable during maintenance periods
exceptions: Concrete Mixer category has a hardcoded 12-hour (720 minute) maintenance window, overriding the dynamic Maintenance Matrix until the official Matrix is published in the next SRS version
conflicts_or_obsolete: The dynamic Maintenance Matrix referenced in SRS v1.2 is not yet finalized; the Concrete Mixer special rule is a temporary hardcoded override pending official Matrix publication
notes: PRIMARY evidence (E1) is an urgent operational override from ops_lead requiring Concrete Mixers to have 12-hour maintenance windows. CONTEXT evidence (E2, E3) establishes the baseline rent lifecycle with dynamic maintenance duration tied to Equipment Category. E8 and E9 confirm that items are marked unavailable during maintenance periods and availability updates automatically. E4 and E7 raise unresolved questions about early completion timing and penalty tolerance windows that should not be assumed as operative rules without explicit confirmation. The Maintenance Matrix itself is not provided, creating a dependency gap for category-specific rules beyond Concrete Mixers.
